_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A saved diff comment stays in the draft review while a recording from the new page retries in one conversation. Use condition waits, never sleep steps. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". {{QUERY}} is the query string that opens the diff viewer on that commit in the repository. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Wait for the clock to start" means: wait until the time element of the stop button no longer reads "00:00" (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time")?.textContent !== "00:00", expect true). "Comment on the commit message" means: click the commit message's line (".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20"), fill ".diff-viewer-comment-input" with "Keep the old name.", and click the button named exactly "Save Comment". The server answers the recording's chat requests with 503 "unavailable" until call "accept chats". Call "drafts" counts the drafts the page made (POST /api/conversations/draft) and makes {{DRAFT_ID}} the first one's id; call "chats" returns the JSON list of the paths chat requests went to. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new?{{QUERY}} and wait for the commit message.
2. Click the start button; the stop button should become visible.
3. Comment on the commit message.
4. The comment does not enter the composer or create a conversation: eval document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value should return exactly ""; call "drafts" should return exactly "0". There is a button with accessible name exactly "Open draft review, 1 comment".
5. Wait for the clock to start, then click the stop button. data-testid "review-recording-error" should contain "unavailable". Call "drafts" should return exactly "1".
6. Call "accept chats", then click data-testid "review-recording-send". It is sent.
7. Both attempts went to the page's draft, and no other was made: call "chats" should return exactly ["/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat","/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat"], and call "drafts" still exactly "1".
8. ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='{{DRAFT_ID}}']" should have class "active" (eval classList.contains("active"), expect true), and the message input's value should still be empty. Click the button with accessible name exactly "Open draft review, 1 comment". The open dialog ".diff-draft-review[open]" has exactly one article containing "Keep the old name.". Call "chats" still returns exactly ["/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat","/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat"]: the comment has not been sent with the recording.
